subject: Civic Hall event-page recovery
method: Wayback CDX enumeration of Civic Hall HTML captures and a separate all-status pass over event-prefix URLs.
findings: No Civic Hall calendar listing or dedicated event-detail page was recovered for the January 2016 New York City Council constituent-services hackathon.
A January 31, 2016 Wayback capture preserves Civic Hall's embedded social feed, including Civic Hall and New York City Council posts.
The Civic Hall-domain Google RSVP form is no longer available and no archived copy was recovered.
epistemicLimit: This supports "not recovered within the documented search," not "no such page ever existed."
publicCitation: Documented Wayback CDX research pass covering 4,630 deduplicated HTML captures and 296 distinct event URL keys; no dedicated event page was recovered.
